title: Three Nights and One Short Thermometer
subtitle: 健康医疗 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 健康医疗（人与自我·生活与学习·健康的生活方式、个人安全与自救）
meta: 主题语境：健康医疗（人与自我·生活与学习·健康的生活方式、个人安全与自救）　|　核心词汇：pill　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 pill 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1973 the nurse ① took the pill that no sufferer in the ward would have counted, and he said the taking was the whole of the night. The ② pill, meaning the tablet itself and not the thermometer, ran three nights and stayed uncounted in the book; a pill, he said, is the only thing in a ward that is judged by how long it is left uncounted.

Every ③ pill in that ward had the same short thermometer beside it, and the ④ pill at the far cupboard, meaning the dose they kept for the children to take and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A pill, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to count; the nurse said the counting is the part that fills three nights.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the pill was the whole of the matter, meaning the cure and not the tablet. The ⑥ pill, meaning the cure and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody counts; pill, he said, is either something you take or the only word that means both a tablet and a cure. He said the cure is the part they remember.

By 1978 the ⑦ pill had become a line in a report, and the report had become an argument about the short thermometer. The ⑧ pill of the whole thing, the nurse wrote in April, was one ward and three nights of counting; pill, he said, is either the dose at the far cupboard or the reason you learned to count. He said the counting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ pill I remember is the tablet counted in the report, which closed in 1980 and is still counted as the quietest in the ward. A ⑩ pill, my mother said in 1982, is the only tablet that improves by being counted; every pill, she said, is a cure that has agreed to look like a tablet. She said the cure was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 药丸（指病房里每一粒旁边的那一粒）
B. n. 药丸（指那粒药丸本身，与细细的体温计相对）
C. 固定搭配：take the pill 服这一粒药丸
D. n. 药丸（指留给孩子们服的那一剂）
E. n. 药丸之事（抽象总称，指一处病房的药丸之事）
F. n. 药丸（指护理记录里写到、被清点的那一粒）
G. n. 药丸、疗效（指一件事里人人都熬却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 疗效（抽象总称，指人人都熬却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: took the pill that no sufferer in the ward would have counted
The pill, meaning the tablet itself and not the thermometer
the pill at the far cupboard
the pill was the whole of the matter
the pill had become a line in a report
The pill of the whole thing
A pill, my mother said in 1982

answers.why: take the pill 意为“服这一粒药丸”，1973 年那位护士把病房里没有一位病患肯清点的一粒药丸做了一遍。
pill 意为“药丸”，指那粒药丸本身而不是细细的体温计，它经过了三个夜晚而在簿子上没有被清点。
pill 意为“药丸”，指病房里每一粒旁边的那一粒，每一粒旁边都有同一支细细的体温计。
pill 意为“药丸”，指最远那格药柜的留给孩子们服的那一剂，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
pill 意为“药丸、疗效”，指一件事里人人都熬却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这粒疗效就是那件事的全部。
pill 意为“疗效”，指人人都熬却无人提起的那样东西而不是那粒药丸，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
pill 意为“药丸”，指护理记录里写到、被清点的那一粒，到 1978 年这一粒成了护理记录里的一行。
pill 意为“药丸之事”，护士四月写道，整件事的药丸之事是一处病房和三个夜晚的清点。
pill 意为“药丸”，我记得的是护理记录里清点过的那一粒，1980 年挺过了，至今仍被说成病房里最安静的一粒。
pill 为抽象总称，母亲 1982 年说，药丸是唯一会因为被好好清点而变得更好的药丸。
